content.text: I think someone stole my jam, what should I do

If someone has stolen your jam, this is considered theft and is a criminal matter that you can report to the police <source>1</source>.[PARAGRAPH_BREAK]When reporting the theft, the police will likely ask you about the type of fruit used in the jam, the location of the theft, and if you have any information about the thief, such as their identity or a description <source>1</source>.[PARAGRAPH_BREAK]After filing the report, you will receive a crime reference number (CRN) which can be used for insurance claims related to the stolen jam <source>1</source>. <options><option>Report jam theft</option><option>Insurance claim for jam</option><option>Jam theft statistics</option></options><sources>{"1": {"title": "FAQ 696e4cf4a58b0f13681b7bcd: What can i do if someone has stolen my jam?1", "view_link": "/app/62f3a2fe0007ff0000000000/page/faqs#faq-696e4cf4a58b0f13681b7bcd", "last_updated": "2026-01-21T16:16:13.815Z", "score": 0.9994755387306213, "faq_id": "696e4cf4a58b0f13681b7bcd", "faq_question": "What can i do if someone has stolen my jam?1"}}</sources>
